  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="SonarAnalyzer.CSharp" Version="10.35.0.4138" PrivateAssets="all" />

  <Target Name="DropSonar" BeforeTargets="CoreCompile">
    <ItemGroup>
      <Analyzer Remove="@(Analyzer->WithMetadataValue('Filename', 'SonarAnalyzer.CSharp'))" />
    </ItemGroup>
  </Target>
